out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt peaceful; 'floated along, like a balloon above the stretcher'; super-excited realization 'I'm in death, this is death!'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Also described being 'sucked downward into a dark void' during the later overdose/cardiac arrest episode.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Slowly but surely being 'sucked toward the light' (first episode); later 'with great speed, I was sucked downward into a dark void' and speed changed with resuscitation.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'something very big' that understood her and brought her back; later a mass of 'unfortunate, angry and mean souls' in a dark void/hellish realm; later (post-NDE dream) a hazy female being in a green-veiled mist.

environment.environment_other_detail: Hospital setting observed during OBE; 'warm golden, yellow light' high in the hall; later 'dark void' and 'kind of hell' with angry souls.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Felt her 'work on Earth was not finished' and feared that once in the light she could never return.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: First episode: brought back by a 'something very big' as she wanted to return; second episode: repeated returns with defibrillation/resuscitation shocks ('each time my heart was resuscitated, with a hard shock I was back in my body').
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: A presence 'planted in my head that I was not ready to go and that I had tasks to do'; later framed purpose as unconditional love and caring for others.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two episodes described: (1) age 17 self-inflicted arterial cut with major blood loss in hospital; (2) later overdose of heroin and cocaine with cardiac arrest and resuscitation/CPR.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised in a rational, anti-religious family; belief that death is eternal dreamless sleep.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Unaffiliated/atheist at the time; expected nothing after death.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hellish/dark-void episode with 'unfortunate, angry and mean souls' during later overdose; repeated back-and-forth with resuscitation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First episode: OBE in hospital → pulled toward warm golden light → panic/threshold decision → return. Second episode: rapid descent into dark void/hellish realm with other souls, repeatedly interrupted by resuscitation shocks returning her to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Second episode repeated transitions between dark void and body with each resuscitation shock.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated oscillation between void/hellish realm and body synchronized with CPR/defibrillation; claimed ability to 'zoom in or zoom out on the world and all humanity' and to hear others' thoughts; post-NDE dream visitation that led to permanent cessation of smoking/drugs.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'I'm in death, this is death!' / 'Help me, I don't want to die! Help me please!' / 'Only what you give, you take with you to the afterlife.'
